root_cause: The V18 canonical shell creates the active mobile header; legacy styles do not target it. A decorative brand mark visually resembles a second hamburger menu. Asynchronously hiding it after DOM ready can itself create CLS on blog routes. Oversized highlight boxes and the fixed zoektijd banner obscured key content.

actions: Apply rules to the active v17-header via canonical components.mjs.
Disable large trustbar only at phone widths.
Remove opaque H1 marker background on phones.
Project the overlay cleanup in final Netlify build stage for generated pages.
Prevent post-paint brand layout shift by hiding the decorative first brand child in canonical mobile CSS, before the first paint; retain existing CLS threshold at 0.100.

evidence.review: Customer-supplied iPhone screenshots reviewed against live homepage and /product

historical_screenshots.observation: Mobile title overflows and yellow marker blocks cover text
Header/hero oversized, timed cost overlay blocks content

evidence.ci_followup: After syncing current main, browser CI identified 3 mobile blog routes at CLS 0.101-0.103; CSS pre-paint fix committed, new CI revalidation required.
